name: mili-ssm
description: mili-ssm's Claude Code plugins: agent-skills (specialist skills and agents) and opt-in mods.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Generic specialist skills and agents (architecture, QA, UX/UI, docs, requirements, security, performance) and cheap offload workers that complement Superpowers and Playwright.

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Mod: compact progress of the active implementation plan, only while there is one: status line (all surfaces) plus a card above the prompt (terminal, desktop).

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Mod: per interaction cycle (your prompt to your next one), how long Claude worked on it, its calls, skills and agents and what it does now: a live status line that stops when the main loop and every agent are done, then one dim line with a Haiku summary of the conclusion and the session's time and tokens; /usage-band for tokens per model.

plugins.name: tool-fold
plugins.description: Mod: tool calls, skills and agents in the chat fold into compact lines; a run of them into one group line with a Haiku summary. Running agents keep a live card in an "Agentes" pane (mission, model, task progress, last calls) until they end. Agent notices shrink to one line.
